Act LXVI of 1992 §11(1) m) lists, among the data the register ('a nyilvántartás', i.e. the personal data and address register, SZL) holds, the ID card's document identifier and the permanent ID card's electronic unique identifier and service identifier; the quote is verbatim and matches the printed statement. The IdomSoft 'Okmány nyilvántartások' quote is also found.

IdomSoft's products page lists 'Országos Jármű Nyilvántartás' (National Vehicle Register) as its product that records and manages data of vehicles registered in Hungary; the kormany.hu quote on the közúti közlekedési nyilvántartás is also found verbatim. 'Built/run by IdomSoft' rests on the system being listed as an IdomSoft product; the page does not explicitly use the word 'operates'.

Act CXXVIII of 2011 §3 point 15 defines 'Lakossági riasztó rendszer' as the public alarm, alarm-information and storm-warning systems in the management ('kezelésében') of the central and territorial organs of the professional disaster management body, exactly as printed. The katasztrofavedelem.hu MoLaRi quote is also present verbatim (split only by underline span markup on 'Mo', 'La', 'Ri').
The MNB page says verbatim '2020. március 2-án elindult az azonnal fizetési szolgáltatás'; the printed date and system match.

Government Decree 386/2016 §1 a) defines 'egészségbiztosítási szerv' to include the Nemzeti Egészségbiztosítási Alapkezelő (NEAK), verbatim; the NEAK English page quote is also found. The printed statement says exactly that.

Decree 386/2016 §7(1) begins 'A NEAK ellátja...' and item e) eb) says it keeps the register of notified persons' insurance-relationship data including entitlement to health services and TAJ certification data (quote verbatim); NEAK's own register page describes the same 'Bejelentett személyek jogviszonyadatainak nyilvántartása'.
